description: This file implements the OmiService class, which manages D-Bus interactions for mounting and unmounting containers, handles system signals, manages privileges, and runs the main event loop for the omi service.

classes.name: OmiService
classes.description: Manages D-Bus interface for mounting/unmounting containers, handles system signals, privilege dropping, and runs the main event loop.

methods.name: OnMount
methods.description: Handles D-Bus mount requests, checks for ID and rootfs path conflicts, performs mount operation, and updates internal state.

methods.name: OnUnmount
methods.description: Handles D-Bus unmount requests, performs unmount operation, and updates internal state.

methods.name: OnBusAcquired
methods.description: Initializes D-Bus skeleton and exports interface upon bus connection.

methods.name: OnNameAcquired
methods.description: Logs when the service name is acquired on D-Bus.

methods.name: OnNameLost
methods.description: Logs when the service name is lost on D-Bus.

methods.name: OnDestroyNotify
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the main loop is destroyed.

methods.name: OnDmVerityError
methods.description: Handles dm-verity errors, extracts container ID from device name, and emits verity failure signal if container is in use.

methods.name: OmiService
methods.description: Constructor, initializes members and logs creation.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Waits for SIGTERM signal and then unowns D-Bus name to initiate shutdown.

methods.name: ChangeRoot
methods.description: Changes root directory and drops privileges based on environment variables.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the service: changes root, sets up D-Bus, and runs the main event loop.
